title: TenancyContext
description: Hierarchical enterprise tenancy. Data isolation boundary: enterprise → tenant → unit → workspace.

enterprise_id.description: Top-level organisation (e.g. MoD, Acme Group). One enterprise may contain many tenants.

tenant_id.description: Tenant within enterprise — primary data contour and policy boundary.

unit_id.description: Optional sub-tenant partition (department, brigade, programme unit). Data scoped below tenant.

workspace_id.description: Optional collaboration scope within tenant/unit. May span units only when policy allows.

contour_id.description: Optional deployment or classification contour (e.g. restricted, disconnected).

company_id.description: Optional joined external company context when actor acts on behalf of a joined company.
